en.s: On 18 January 350, Magnentius was proclaimed Augustus in Gaul, challenging the rule of the Roman emperor Constans.

zh.t: 马格嫩提乌斯被拥立为皇帝
zh.s: 公元350年1月18日，马格嫩提乌斯在高卢被拥立为奥古斯都，挑战罗马皇帝君士坦斯的统治。

en.t: Emperor Huizong abdicates in favour of Qinzong
en.s: On 18 January 1126, Emperor Huizong of the Song dynasty abdicated in favour of his son, Emperor Qinzong, as Jin forces threatened the Song capital.
en.n: The date follows the historical calendar convention used by the source.

zh.s: 1126年1月18日，金军威胁宋朝都城之际，宋徽宗退位，将皇位传给儿子宋钦宗。
zh.n: 日期沿用来源所用的历史历法记法。

en.s: On 18 January 1535, the Spanish foundation ceremony of Lima took place at what is now the Plaza Mayor in Peru. The settlement was named Ciudad de los Reyes.

zh.t: 利马举行西班牙殖民城市奠基仪式
zh.s: 1535年1月18日，利马作为西班牙殖民城市的奠基仪式在今秘鲁利马主广场举行，新城被命名为“诸王之城”。

en.s: On January 18, 1546, Gonzalo Pizarro’s forces defeated those of royal viceroy Blasco Núñez Vela at Iñaquito, near Quito in present-day Ecuador. The viceroy was killed in the battle.

zh.s: 1546年1月18日，贡萨洛·皮萨罗的军队在今厄瓜多尔基多附近的伊尼亚基托击败王室总督布拉斯科·努涅斯·贝拉的军队，总督在战斗中丧生。

en.s: The Tenshō earthquake (Japanese: 天正地震, Hepburn: Tenshō Jishin) occurred in Japan on January 18, 1586, at 23:00 local time. This earthquake had an estimated seismic magnitude (MJMA) of 7.9, and an epicenter in Honshu's Chūbu region. It caused an estimated 8,000 fatalities and damaged 10,000 houses across the prefectures of Toyama, Hyōgo, Kyōto, Osaka, Nara, Mie, Aichi, Gifu, Fukui, Ishikawa and Shizuoka.

zh.s: 1586年1月18日当地时间23时，日本发生天正地震，估计日本气象厅震级为7.9级，震中位于本州中部地区。地震估计造成8,000人死亡，富山、兵库、京都、大阪、奈良、三重、爱知、岐阜、福井、石川及静冈各地共一万座房屋受损。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: On 18 January 1636, Dutch forces defeated a Portuguese force at Mata Redonda in Brazil during the struggle over Dutch Brazil.

zh.s: 1636年1月18日，荷兰军队在巴西马塔雷东达击败葡萄牙军队，这是双方争夺荷属巴西期间的一场战斗。

en.s: On 18 January 1639, Mysore forces led by Kanthirava Narasaraja I defeated the Bijapur army besieging Seringapatam, in present-day India. A night attack on the besiegers’ camp helped break the siege.

zh.s: 1639年1月18日，坎提拉瓦·纳拉萨拉贾一世率迈索尔军队击败围攻斯里兰加帕特纳姆的比贾布尔军队。迈索尔军夜袭围城部队营地，帮助解除围困。该地位于今印度境内。

en.s: The Battle of Warksow took place on the Baltic Sea island of Rügen on 8 January (O.S.)/18 January（N.S.）1678 during the Swedish-Brandenburg War. In the battle Swedish forces defeated an allied army composed mainly of Danes supported by a smaller contingent of Brandenburg and Hesse-Cassel troops. The Swedes were able to muster some 3,500 men for the battle, including 2,000 cavalry.

zh.s: 瓦尔克索战役发生于瑞典—勃兰登堡战争期间，时间为1678年旧历1月8日，即新历1月18日，地点在波罗的海吕根岛。瑞典军队击败了以丹麦军队为主、另有少量勃兰登堡和黑森-卡塞尔军队支援的联军。瑞军共约3,500人，其中包括2,000名骑兵。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Frederick I crowns himself King in Prussia
en.s: On 18 January 1701, Frederick I crowned himself King in Prussia at Königsberg, now Kaliningrad, Russia. He had previously ruled as Frederick III, Elector of Brandenburg and Duke of Prussia.

zh.t: 腓特烈一世加冕为“在普鲁士的国王”
zh.s: 1701年1月18日，腓特烈一世在柯尼斯堡，即今俄罗斯加里宁格勒，自行加冕为“在普鲁士的国王”。他此前以腓特烈三世之名统治勃兰登堡和普鲁士，担任勃兰登堡选侯及普鲁士公爵。

en.s: The Bavarian uprising of 1705–1706 (German: Bayerische Volkserhebung, "Bavarian people's uprising") was a revolt against the occupation of the Electorate of Bavaria by the Imperial Army of the Habsburg Monarchy during the War of the Spanish Succession (1701–1714). It lasted from early November 1705 to 18 January 1706, approximately 75 days. Henric L. Wuermeling speaks of this as "the first revolution of modern history."
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1705至1706年巴伐利亚起义，是西班牙王位继承战争期间，反对哈布斯堡王朝帝国军队占领巴伐利亚选侯国的起义。起义从1705年11月初持续至1706年1月18日，约75天。亨里克·L.维尔梅林将其称为“近代历史上的第一次革命”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1724 Taunton by-election to the Parliament of Great Britain was held on 18 January 1724 in Taunton, Somerset, following the death of the incumbent, John Trenchard. The by-election was contested by Abraham Elton, George Deane, William Molyneux and Griffith Pugh. Elton, a Whig who had been a late entrant to the election won, and despite a petition from Deane, was returned as the Member of Parliament for Taunton.

zh.s: 1724年1月18日，英国萨默塞特郡汤顿举行国会补选，填补约翰·特伦查德去世留下的席位。参选者为亚伯拉罕·埃尔顿、乔治·迪恩、威廉·莫利纽克斯及格里菲思·普尤。较晚加入竞选的辉格党人埃尔顿获胜；尽管迪恩提出请愿挑战结果，埃尔顿仍被确认当选汤顿议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: Cape Colony capitulation signed after Blaauwberg
en.s: On 18 January 1806, Jan Willem Janssens and William Beresford signed articles of capitulation following the Battle of Blaauwberg in present-day South Africa. David Baird ratified the agreement on 19 January.

zh.t: 布劳堡战役后签署开普殖民地投降条款
zh.s: 1806年1月18日，布劳堡战役后，扬·威廉·扬森斯与威廉·贝雷斯福德在今南非境内签署投降条款。戴维·贝尔德于1月19日批准协议。

en.s: The combat of Villaseca was a Spanish victory during the Peninsular War, when an irregular Spanish force of over 3,000 somatenes, led by Baron de Eroles, ambushed a column of French troops in the village of Vila-seca, Tarragona, on 18 January 1812. General Lafosse, the governor of Tortosa, was on his way to relieve Tarragona with an infantry battalion and a troop of dragoons, when he was surprised by Eroles, at the head of over 3,000 somatenes, at Villaseca.

zh.s: 1812年1月18日，半岛战争期间，埃罗莱斯男爵率领3,000多名西班牙地方民兵，在塔拉戈纳的比拉塞卡村伏击一支法军纵队，取得胜利。托尔托萨总督拉福斯将军原本率一个步兵营和一队龙骑兵前往增援塔拉戈纳，途中遭到埃罗莱斯指挥的民兵突袭。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Battles of Frenchtown, also known as the Battle of the River Raisin and the River Raisin Massacre, was a series of conflicts that took place from January 18–23, 1813 during the War of 1812. It was fought between the United States and a British and Native American alliance near the River Raisin in Frenchtown, Michigan Territory (present-day Monroe, Michigan). The battle on January 22 had the highest number of fatalities of any battle during this war. On January 18, 1813 the Americans forced the retreat of the British and their Native American allies from Frenchtown, which they had earlier occupied, in a relatively minor skirmish.

zh.s: 1813年1月18日至23日，1812年战争中的一系列冲突，在密歇根领地弗伦奇敦的雷曾河附近展开，当地即今密歇根州门罗。美国军队与英国及原住民联盟交战，相关战斗也称雷曾河战役及雷曾河惨案。1月22日的战斗，是这场战争中单场死亡人数最多的一战。1月18日，美军先在一场较小规模的交火中，迫使此前占领弗伦奇敦的英军及其原住民盟友撤退。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 18 January 1817, Patriot forces attempted to capture Angostura, now Ciudad Bolívar in Venezuela. Unable to penetrate the Spanish defences, they withdrew.

zh.t: 第一次安戈斯图拉战役
zh.s: 1817年1月18日，委内瑞拉独立派军队试图夺取安戈斯图拉，即今委内瑞拉玻利瓦尔城。由于无法突破西班牙守军的防线，他们撤退了。

en.s: On 18 January 1836, Carlist forces pushed back Liberal troops at Arlabán in Spain during the First Carlist War. The Liberals had occupied the heights on 16–17 January.

zh.t: 卡洛斯派在阿尔拉班反击
zh.s: 1836年1月18日，第一次卡洛斯战争期间，卡洛斯派军队在西班牙阿尔拉班击退自由派军队。自由派此前于1月16日至17日占领当地高地。

en.t: Wesley College receives its first pupil
en.s: On 18 January 1866, Frederick Binks arrived as the first pupil at Wesley College in Melbourne, Australia. The college had been formally founded on 11 January; boarding pupils were received from 18 January and day pupils from 22 January.

zh.t: 墨尔本卫斯理学院迎来首名学生
zh.s: 1866年1月18日，弗雷德里克·宾克斯成为澳大利亚墨尔本卫斯理学院的首名学生。学校已于1月11日正式创立，从1月18日起接收寄宿生，1月22日起接收走读生。

en.t: Wilhelm I proclaimed German emperor at Versailles
en.s: On 18 January 1871, Wilhelm I was proclaimed German emperor in the Hall of Mirrors at the Palace of Versailles in France. The ceremony took place near the end of the Franco-Prussian War.

zh.t: 威廉一世在凡尔赛被宣布为德意志皇帝
zh.s: 1871年1月18日，威廉一世在法国凡尔赛宫镜厅被宣布为德意志皇帝。仪式举行时，普法战争已接近尾声。

en.s: The Ontario general election of 1875 was the third general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on January 18, 1875, to elect the 88 Members of the 3rd Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Oliver Mowat, increased its majority in the Legislature for its second term in government.

zh.s: 1875年1月18日，加拿大安大略省举行第三次大选，选出第三届省议会88名议员。奥利弗·莫厄特领导的安大略自由党扩大多数优势，赢得第二个执政任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: 1881 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1881 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 18, 1881, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1881年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1881年1月18日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第一组参议员席位的代表。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Battle of Mazocoba, or the Mazocoba massacre, was a major engagement of the Yaqui Wars that was fought in Sonora, Mexico. On January 18, 1900, a Mexican Army expedition encountered hundreds of Yaqui renegades about twenty miles east of Guaymas. During the battle that followed, several hundred people were killed or wounded and over 1,000 Yaquis were taken prisoner.

zh.s: 1900年1月18日，墨西哥索诺拉州爆发马索科巴战役，也称马索科巴屠杀，是雅基战争中的一场重要战斗。一支墨西哥陆军远征队，在瓜伊马斯以东约20英里处遇见数百名脱离政府控制的雅基人。随后交战造成数百人死伤，超过1,000名雅基人被俘。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On January 18, 1910, the 1910–11 United States Senate election cycle began. Elections were held on different dates in different states, and senators were primarily chosen by state legislatures before the Seventeenth Amendment.

zh.t: 1910至1911年美国参议院选举周期开始
zh.s: 1910年1月18日，1910至1911年美国参议院选举周期开始。各州在不同日期举行选举；当时宪法第十七修正案尚未通过，参议员主要由州议会选出。

en.t: Japanese prime minister Ōkuma Shigenobu issued the Twenty-One Demands to China in a bid to increase Japan's power in East Asia
en.s: The Twenty-One Demands was a set of demands made during the First World War by the Empire of Japan under Prime Minister Ōkuma Shigenobu to the government of the Republic of China on 18 January 1915. The secret demands would greatly extend Japanese control of China. Japan would keep the former German leased territory it had conquered at the start of World War I in 1914 and would have increased influence in Manchuria and Inner Mongolia while having an expanded role in railways.

zh.t: 日本向中国提出“二十一条”
zh.s: 1915年1月18日，第一次世界大战期间，大隈重信内阁领导下的日本帝国向中华民国政府提出“二十一条”。这组秘密要求将大幅扩大日本对中国的控制，包括保有日本在1914年战争初期夺取的原德国租借地、扩大在满洲和内蒙古的影响，以及加强对铁路的干预。

en.s: Battle of Laagna (Estonian: Laagna lahing; January 18, 1919) took place in Laagna, Estonia, during the Estonian War of Independence with Estonian mariners and Finnish volunteers against the Red Army. In the morning the Estonians and Finns took Laagna village with a surprise attack and pushed the Red Army out. Against the Estonian mariners and Finnish volunteers (220 men altogether) were two regiments of Red Army infantry, two armored trains and some cavalry. The Russians repeatedly attacked the Estonian and Finnish positions with armored trains but were unable to capture Laagna and were driven back with heavy losses.

zh.s: 1919年1月18日，爱沙尼亚独立战争期间，爱沙尼亚海军人员与芬兰志愿军在拉格纳迎战红军。当天早晨，他们突然进攻，夺下拉格纳村，将红军逐出。爱沙尼亚与芬兰一方共220人，对面是两个红军步兵团、两列装甲列车及部分骑兵。俄军多次利用装甲列车进攻，但未能夺回拉格纳，反而遭重创后被击退。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 18 January 1919, the Paris Peace Conference opened in France after the First World War. The victorious Allies began setting the terms of peace with the defeated Central Powers.

zh.s: 1919年1月18日，第一次世界大战后的巴黎和会在法国开幕。战胜的协约国开始为战败的同盟国制定和平条件。

en.s: On 18 January 1932, miners at the Sant Corneli colony in Fígols, Catalonia, Spain, began a wildcat strike demanding better living and working conditions. It developed into the Alt Llobregat insurrection.
en.n: Most of the cited accounts place the opening strike on January 18; some historians give January 19.

zh.t: 菲戈尔斯矿工罢工开始
zh.s: 1932年1月18日，西班牙加泰罗尼亚菲戈尔斯的圣科尔内利矿区工人发起自发罢工，要求改善生活和工作条件。这场罢工随后发展为上略夫雷加特起义。
zh.n: 所引资料多数将罢工开始日期记为1月18日，也有历史学者记为1月19日。

en.t: Voting begins in the 1937 British Indian provincial elections
en.s: On 18 January 1937, voting began in Assam and Bengal as part of the provincial elections in British India. Polling across the provinces continued on different dates into February. These historical provinces include territory in present-day India and Bangladesh.

zh.t: 1937年英属印度省级选举开始投票
zh.s: 1937年1月18日，阿萨姆和孟加拉开始省级选举投票。英属印度其他省份在不同日期举行投票，持续至2月。这两个历史省份的范围包括今印度和孟加拉国的部分地区。

en.s: The 1943 Pinsk Prison raid was one of the most spectacular raids in the history of the Home Army and the Polish Underground State. It took place on January 18, 1943 in Pinsk, the town in Eastern Poland (now in Belarus), which at that time was under German occupation as part of Reichskommissariat Ukraine. The purpose of the raid was to release a Cichociemni agent and his comrades, who had been captured by the Germans while trying to blow up the Horyn river bridge.

zh.s: 1943年1月18日，波兰家乡军在平斯克发动监狱突袭，被视为家乡军及波兰地下国历史上最出色的突袭行动之一。平斯克当时属于波兰东部，今位于白俄罗斯，彼时由德军占领，划入乌克兰总督辖区。行动目的是营救一名“寂静无声者”特工及其同伴，他们此前企图炸毁霍伦河桥时被德国人捕获。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Armed resistance to deportations in the Warsaw Ghetto
en.s: On 18 January 1943, German forces began another deportation of Jews from the Warsaw Ghetto in occupied Poland. Jewish resistance fighters engaged them in armed clashes. This January resistance preceded the larger uprising of April 1943.

zh.t: 华沙犹太区武装抵抗驱逐
zh.s: 1943年1月18日，德军再次从被占领波兰的华沙犹太区驱逐犹太人，犹太抵抗组织的战士与德军发生武装冲突。这次1月的抵抗早于同年4月爆发的大规模起义。

en.s: Operation Konrad III was a German military offensive on the Eastern Front of the Second World War. It was the third and most ambitious of the three Konrad Operations and had the objective of relieving the siege of Budapest and recapturing the entire Transdanubia region. Achieving complete surprise, the German offensive began on 18 January 1945.

zh.s: 康拉德三号行动是第二次世界大战东线的一次德军攻势，也是三次康拉德行动中规模最大、目标最广的一次，旨在解围布达佩斯并重新夺取整个外多瑙地区。德军于1945年1月18日发动进攻，完全出乎对手意料。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: On 18 January 1955, French Army forces and Algeria’s National Liberation Army fought the Battle of Douar Souadek, also known as the Battle of Boukerker.

zh.s: 1955年1月18日，法国陆军与阿尔及利亚民族解放军展开杜瓦尔苏阿代克战役，又称布凯尔凯尔战役。

en.t: PLA lands on the Yijiangshan Islands
en.s: On 18 January 1955, the People’s Liberation Army landed on the Yijiangshan Islands during the First Taiwan Strait Crisis. Aircraft and artillery supported the assault on Republic of China positions.

zh.s: 1955年1月18日，第一次台海危机期间，中国人民解放军登陆一江山岛。航空兵和炮兵支援了对中华民国军队阵地的进攻。

en.s: Capital Airlines Flight 20 was a U.S. scheduled passenger flight from Washington, D.C. to Norfolk, Virginia. A Vickers Viscount flying the route crashed into a farm in Charles City County, Virginia, on January 18, 1960. The accident was the fourth fatal crash involving a Capital Viscount in less than two years; the first three were Capital Airlines Flight 67 (April 1958), Capital Airlines Flight 300 (May 1958) and Capital Airlines Flight 75 (May 1959).

zh.t: 美国首都航空20号班机空难
zh.s: 1960年1月18日，美国首都航空20号班机，一架维克斯“子爵”客机，在弗吉尼亚州查尔斯城县一座农场坠毁。这是从华盛顿特区飞往弗吉尼亚州诺福克的定期客运航班，也是该公司“子爵”客机不到两年内第四起致命事故。此前三起分别为1958年4月的67号班机、1958年5月的300号班机，以及1959年5月的75号班机。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: On 18 January 1964, at 20:04 local time, a magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck Baihe in Taiwan. The earthquake killed 106 people, destroyed 10,924 buildings and caused a major fire in Chiayi.

zh.s: 1964年1月18日当地时间20时04分，台湾白河发生里氏6.3级地震，造成106人死亡、10,924栋建筑被毁，并引发嘉义大火。

en.t: Jeremy Thorpe elected Liberal Party leader
en.s: On 18 January 1967, Jeremy Thorpe won the leadership election of Britain’s Liberal Party. The election followed Jo Grimond’s resignation after disappointing results in the 1966 general election.

zh.t: 杰里米·索普当选英国自由党领袖
zh.s: 1967年1月18日，杰里米·索普赢得英国自由党党首选举。此前，乔·格里蒙德因该党在1966年大选中表现不佳而辞职。

en.s: United Airlines Flight 266 was a scheduled passenger flight from Los Angeles International Airport, California, to General Mitchell International Airport, Milwaukee, Wisconsin, via Stapleton International Airport, Denver, Colorado. On January 18, 1969, at approximately 18:21 PST, the Boeing 727 operating the flight crashed into Santa Monica Bay, Pacific Ocean, about 11.5 miles (18.5 km) west of Los Angeles International Airport, four minutes after takeoff, killing all 38 on board.

zh.s: 联合航空266号班机原定从加利福尼亚州洛杉矶国际机场起飞，经科罗拉多州丹佛斯泰普尔顿国际机场，前往威斯康星州密尔沃基的米切尔将军国际机场。1969年1月18日太平洋标准时间约18时21分，执行该航班的波音727在起飞四分钟后坠入太平洋圣莫尼卡湾，地点在洛杉矶国际机场以西约11.5英里（18.5公里），机上38人全部遇难。

en.s: The Karantina massacre (Arabic: مجزرة الكرنتينا; French: Massacre de La Quarantaine/Karantina) took place on 18 January 1976, early in the Lebanese Civil War. La Quarantine, known in Arabic as "Karantina", was a Muslim-inhabited district in mostly Christian East Beirut controlled by forces of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) and the Lebanese National Movement (LNM), and inhabited by Palestinians, Kurds, Armenians, Syrians, and Lebanese Muslims.

zh.s: 卡兰蒂纳屠杀发生于1976年1月18日，当时黎巴嫩内战刚开始不久。卡兰蒂纳是东贝鲁特一处穆斯林居民聚居区，而东贝鲁特总体以基督徒为主。该区由巴勒斯坦解放组织和黎巴嫩民族运动的武装控制，居民包括巴勒斯坦人、库尔德人、亚美尼亚人、叙利亚人及黎巴嫩穆斯林。

en.s: On Tuesday, 18 January 1977 at Granville, a western suburb of Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, a crowded commuter train led by a 46 class locomotive derailed, running into the supports of a road bridge that collapsed onto two of the train's passenger carriages. While the official inquiry found the primary cause of the crash to be poor fastening of the track, there were a number of factors that were identified as contributing to the accident. It remains the deadliest rail disaster in Australian history; 83 people died and 213 were injured. An 84th victim, an unborn child, was added to the fatality list in 2017.

zh.t: 澳大利亚格兰维尔铁路惨案
zh.s: 1977年1月18日星期二，澳大利亚新南威尔士州悉尼西郊格兰维尔，一列由46型机车牵引的拥挤通勤列车脱轨，撞上公路桥支柱，桥梁随即坍塌，压住两节客车。官方调查认为，轨道固定不良是主要原因，同时认定还有其他促成因素。事故造成83人死亡、213人受伤，是澳大利亚历史上死亡人数最多的铁路灾难。2017年，一名未出生婴儿被列为第84名遇难者。

en.t: CDC announces identification of the Legionnaires’ disease bacterium
en.s: On January 18, 1977, a special issue of the CDC’s Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report announced identification of the bacterium responsible for Legionnaires’ disease. The discovery followed investigation of the 1976 outbreak in Philadelphia.

zh.t: 美国疾控中心宣布确认军团病病原菌
zh.s: 1977年1月18日，美国疾控中心通过《发病率和死亡率周报》特刊宣布，已确认引发军团病的细菌。这一发现来自对1976年费城疫情的调查。

en.t: Yugoslav prime minister Džemal Bijedić killed in air crash
en.s: On 18 January 1977, Yugoslav prime minister Džemal Bijedić, his wife Razija and six others died when their Learjet 25 crashed on Inač mountain near Kreševo, in present-day Bosnia and Herzegovina.

zh.t: 南斯拉夫总理杰马尔·比耶迪奇空难身亡
zh.s: 1977年1月18日，南斯拉夫总理杰马尔·比耶迪奇、妻子拉齐娅及另外六人乘坐的里尔25型飞机，在今波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那克雷舍沃附近的伊纳奇山坠毁，机上人员遇难。

en.s: On 18 January 1982, Finland completed two days of public voting to choose presidential electors. The electors subsequently elected Mauno Koivisto, the first Social Democrat to become the country’s president.

zh.t: 芬兰1982年总统选举人投票结束
zh.s: 1982年1月18日，芬兰为期两天的总统选举人投票结束。选举人随后选出毛诺·科伊维斯托，使他成为该国首位社会民主党籍总统。

en.s: The 1986 Aerovías Guatemala air crash occurred on 18 January 1986 and involved a Sud Aviation SE-210 Caravelle III that crashed into a hill on approach to Santa Elena Airport, Flores, Guatemala after a short flight from Guatemala City's La Aurora International Airport. All 93 passengers and crew on board were killed, making it the worst air disaster in Guatemalan history.

zh.t: 1986年危地马拉Aerovías航空“快帆”客机空难
zh.s: 1986年1月18日，危地马拉Aerovías航空一架法国南方航空制造公司SE-210“快帆”III客机，在进近弗洛雷斯的圣埃莱娜机场时撞山。飞机此前从危地马拉城拉奥罗拉国际机场起飞，航程不长。机上93名乘客及机组人员全部遇难，成为危地马拉历史上最严重的空难。

en.s: On January 18, 1988, Manila held local elections as part of the Philippine nationwide local elections. Voters chose the mayor, vice mayor and city councillors.

en.s: Local elections were held in Naga City, Camarines Sur, on January 18, 1988, as part of the nationwide local elections. Voters elected the mayor, vice mayor, and members of the Sangguniang Panlungsod (city council). These were the first local elections after the 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution and the ratification of the 1987 Constitution.

zh.s: 1988年1月18日，菲律宾南甘马粦省那牙市举行地方选举，作为全国地方选举的一部分。选民选出市长、副市长和市议会议员。这是1986年人民力量革命及1987年宪法获批准后的首次地方选举。

en.t: 2015 Democratic Party of Japan leadership election
en.s: The 2015 Democratic Party of Japan presidential election was held on 18 January 2015. The election was held to replace outgoing president Banri Kaieda, who resigned after losing his seat in the December 2014 general election. Katsuya Okada was victorious in a close contest with Goshi Hosono after two rounds of voting, returning to the position he held from 2004 until 2005.

zh.s: 2015年1月18日，日本民主党举行代表选举，接替在2014年12月大选中失去议席后辞职的海江田万里。冈田克也经过两轮投票，在与细野豪志的激烈竞争中获胜，重新出任他曾于2004年至2005年担任的党代表。

en.s: On 18 January 2019, a pipeline transporting gasoline exploded in the town of Tlahuelilpan, in the Mexican state of Hidalgo. The blast killed at least 137 people and injured dozens more. Mexican authorities blamed fuel thieves, who had illegally tapped the pipeline. The explosion was particularly deadly because large crowds of people had gathered at the scene to steal fuel. Security forces tried to persuade people to move away from the scene, but they were outnumbered and asked not to engage with civilians for fear of causing a violent confrontation. The leak was reported at 17:04 CST (23:04 UTC), and the explosion occurred two hours later at 19:10.

zh.t: 墨西哥特拉韦利尔潘输油管爆炸
zh.s: 2019年1月18日，墨西哥伊达尔戈州特拉韦利尔潘镇的一条汽油输送管道爆炸，造成至少137人死亡、数十人受伤。当局认定，盗油者非法打孔取油是事故原因。由于大批民众聚集现场盗取燃油，爆炸尤其惨重。安全部队曾劝人离开，但人数不及人群，又因担心引发暴力冲突而被要求避免与平民交锋。中部标准时间17时04分，即协调世界时23时04分，首次报告泄漏，两小时后的19时10分发生爆炸。

en.s: On 18 January 2023, a Ukrainian Eurocopter EC225 Super Puma carrying ten people, including Ukrainian Minister of Internal Affairs Denys Monastyrsky, his deputy Yevhen Yenin, and State Secretary Yurii Lubkovych, crashed into a kindergarten in Brovary, a suburb of Kyiv, Ukraine. zh.t: 2023年乌克兰布罗瓦里直升机坠毁事故

en.s: On 18 January 2026, a high-speed passenger train derailed in the municipality of Adamuz, in the province of Córdoba, Spain. The derailment occurred on a straight section of the Madrid–Seville high-speed rail line that was last refurbished in May 2025. A second train crashed into it and was also derailed. The incident killed 46 people including the Renfe train driver and injured 292 others, including 15 in critical condition. The crash was Spain's worst railway disaster since the Santiago de Compostela derailment in 2013, and the fourth deadliest railway accident ever recorded in the country.

zh.t: 2026年西班牙阿达穆斯铁路惨案
zh.s: 2026年1月18日，一列高速客运列车在西班牙科尔多瓦省阿达穆斯脱轨，地点位于马德里—塞维利亚高速铁路线的一段直线轨道，该段最近于2025年5月翻修。另一列火车撞上脱轨列车，也发生脱轨。事故造成46人死亡，包括西班牙国家铁路列车司机，另有292人受伤，其中15人情况危急。这是西班牙自2013年圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉脱轨事故以来最严重的铁路灾难，也是该国有记录以来死亡人数第四多的铁路事故。

en.s: The 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final was a football match played on 18 January 2026 at the Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium in Rabat, Morocco. It determined the winners of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON), the 35th edition of the biennial African tournament organised by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), and was contested between Senegal and hosts Morocco.

zh.s: 2026年1月18日，2025年度非洲国家杯决赛在摩洛哥拉巴特的穆莱·阿卜杜拉王子体育场举行，由塞内加尔对阵东道主摩洛哥，决出本届冠军。这是非洲足联每两年举办一次的赛事的第35届。
